name: Yeti
outlook:
What Yeti says to expect

  • Fiscal 2026: adjusted salesAdjusted sales to increase approximately 6% (versus previous outlook of 7% to 8%), reflecting a more cautious consumer environment through the balance of the year;
  • Fiscal 2026: adjusted earnings per shareAdjusted net income per diluted share between $2.90 and $2.95, representing growth of approximately 16% to 18% (versus previous outlook of $2.94 to $3.00);
  • Fiscal 2026: capital expendituresCapital expenditures of approximately $60 million to $70 million (consistent with previous outlook); and
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 12, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
